title: danthonia rigida var. teretifolia
intro: Danthonia rigida var. teretifolia, commonly known as prairie grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat wounds and skin conditions due to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Danthonia rigida var. teretifolia include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health.
